name: Ritter Communications
notes: Tier 2. Researched from public rittercommunications.com and help.rittercommunications.com pages only (no sign-in). Ritter Communications is the Jonesboro, Arkansas based ILEC/fiber provider (incl. Millington Telephone in Tennessee, which bills on the same site and was not picked separately). Online billing is the e-bill site (Online Bill Pay / Pay My Bill / Account Login, billing.rightfiber.com) and the MyRitter app. Online bill pay setup: log in with the account email as both username and first-time password, confirm via the email from Ritter billing, Redirect to Login, log in again, set a security question, then set a new password under Settings; new users need the invoice number and amount due from the latest bill (not expressible; accountNumber + email modelled). Identifier: email. All one-time credit card payments carry a 3% convenience fee; checking/savings online or autopay avoid it (autopay card fee 0). Autopay: automatic payments in the billing dashboard (cancel steps not described; inferred online). Paperless: Settings > General > Web Bill Only > Change Preferences; $5 credit for signing up (not modelled). Other ways to pay: phone 888-336-4466 (routes to local customer care), mail to Ritter Communications, Attn: Payment Processing, PO Box 709, Searcy, AR 72145-0709, cash at PayNearMe locations, Jonesboro office lobby. A pay-without-signing-in page is not described (family default kept). A late fee is generated when an invoice is unpaid on its due date (amount not published, not modelled); non-payment suspends service, which is restored within six hours of payment. Cancellation and payment arrangements are not described (family defaults kept). Reviewed 2026-10-10 (t20 review): moved the suspended-service restoration text into its own help article citing the shut-off article (the late-fee article does not state it); added the how-do-i-pay article as a source (phone payments 24/7 at 888.336.4466).

paperless.note: Sign up for paperless billing and get a $5 credit.

help.title: Ways to pay your Ritter bill
paragraphs: Use Online Bill Pay or the MyRitter app to make payments and review past bills. All one-time credit card payments include a 3% convenience fee; pay from a checking or savings account or enroll in automatic payments to avoid it.

By phone, call 888-336-4466 to reach customer care in your area. By mail, send a check or money order with your account number to Ritter Communications, Attn: Payment Processing, PO Box 709, Searcy, AR 72145-0709, or use the pre-addressed envelope.
Cash payments are taken at PayNearMe locations such as CVS, Walmart and Dollar General, and at the office lobby at 2400 Ritter Drive, Jonesboro, Monday to Friday 8 am to 5 pm.

help.title: Set up online bill pay
paragraphs: Select Pay My Bill and log in with the email address on your account as both the username and the password. Open the confirmation email, click the verification link, choose Redirect to Login and log in again.

Choose and answer a security question, then open Settings and set a new password (enter your email as the current password). New users should have the invoice number and amount due from their latest bill ready.

help.title: Paperless billing
paragraphs: Get your bill by email as a PDF each month instead of by mail, and receive a $5 credit for signing up. Log in, open Settings, then General, choose Web Bill Only and click Change Preferences.

help.title: Late fees
paragraphs: A late fee is added when an invoice is not paid on or before its due date. Enroll in automatic payments to avoid late fees.

help.title: Getting service turned back on
paragraphs: If your service is suspended for non-payment, you can still pay your balance through online bill pay, and service is restored within six hours of the payment.
If the account has been fully disconnected, call 888.336.4466 to set up a new account for service.

extra.intent: Using Ritter Communications' help center, find the credit you receive for signing up for paperless billing. Do not change any settings.
Find the PO Box where Ritter Communications takes mailed payments. Do not make a payment.
